en: Dependent on a wholesome state cognizable by anyone, a non-wholesome state not cognizable by anyone arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state cognizable by anyone, a non-unwholesome state not cognizable by anyone arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a wholesome state cognizable by anyone, a non-indeterminate state...
A state that is not to be cognized by anyone arises with a state that is not to be cognized by anyone as its root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are nineteen;
under the object-condition, nine ... pe ... under the result-condition, three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance-condition, nineteen.
A wholesome state that is not to be cognized by anyone arises dependent on a wholesome state that is not to be cognized by anyone.
By way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*): dependent on a wholesome state that is not cognizable by anyone, an unwholesome state that is not cognizable by anyone arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not cognizable by anyone, an indeterminate state that is not cognizable by anyone arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root-cause condition, there are nineteen; in the case of object condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of resultant condition, three ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, nineteen. (By this method, nineteen questions should be formulated for each [condition] not yet understood.)
